title: Club Membership: group fitness class booking by tier
content:
## Scope
This document states, for every Club Membership tier, whether standard group fitness classes are included at no extra charge, and how far ahead of a class the member may book.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Group fitness classes included at no extra charge | How far ahead a class may be booked |
|---|---|---|
| Base Club Access | No | 0 hours (class booking not included) |
| Student Metro Access | Yes | 24 hours ahead |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | No | 0 hours (class booking not included) |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | Yes | 48 hours ahead |
| Premier All-Access | Yes | 72 hours ahead |
| Black Card All-Access | Yes | 168 hours ahead |
| Founding Legacy Access | Yes | 72 hours ahead |

## Reading the table
Where a tier does not include group fitness classes at no extra charge, that tier carries no advance booking window under this basis; where a tier does include class booking, the advance booking window is the greatest number of hours ahead of the class start that the member may reserve a spot.
